description: Source readers (spec/cli/sources.md, section 2). Each case reads the fixture file named by input as the project path file, with the recipe fixture of ../recipes named by recipe (or that fixture with the keys of set replaced), the import's object and the connection being imported; expected is readSourceFile's result, or refused the reasons. forbidden lists text that must appear nowhere in the result or its reasons.
